name: Line Boil
visualIdentity: Illustrated contours subtly cycle through two or three aligned drawings at a stable cadence, creating a living hand-drawn shimmer. Keep changes small and preserve silhouette, glyph structure, and position. This is a supplemental reference, not a claimed canonical source style.
suitableUses: Explicitly suited to illustrations, titles, hand-lettered copy, and simple explanatory diagrams. It can stand alone or support typographic sequencing and diagram drawing. These are suggested uses, not guaranteed outcomes.
limitations: Requires carefully prepared contour variants; a jittery mouth alone does not qualify. Independent per-frame noise distracts and can distort identity or lettering. Omit or adapt when suitable line art is unavailable. No canonical palette or actual source production method is claimed.
palette: The optional suggestion is two-tone ink (#354142) on cream (#F6EFDF), with stable colors and no gradient. Supplied, brand, reference, semantic, and asset colors take precedence; do not recolor artwork or add accent hues. Use patterns or opacity for tone. Check contrast on actual composites.
motionAndInteraction: Cycle cached variants on explicit exposure holds, coordinated with subject motion; preserve the boil cadence through other easing. For video, derive state from seekable composition time. For HTML, variants may swap on a fixed cadence, optionally alongside scroll reveals. Keep reduced-motion/static states and DOM text for accessibility; motion references are optional, not required.
audio: No fixed soundtrack is specified. Choose music, narration, effects, ambience, or silence for the subject and audience; honor supplied audio choices. Synchronize and mix with picture, preserving intelligible speech and avoiding clipping.
assetRequirements: Prepare two or three aligned line-art variants and inspect silhouette correspondence. Keep fonts and assets local and cache generated geometry. Rough.js can create seeded sketch-like contours, but does not provide authentic drawing media, handwriting, or character poses. SVG or Canvas can render lines.
combinations: Works alone for a two-tone hand-drawn shimmer. Kinetic typography (style-093) can order boiled lettering; whiteboard diagrams (style-026) can draw in causal order then boil completed lines. Preserve two colors, line and label amplitude differences, and readable holds; avoid random distortion, identical spring-bounce, accents, and boiling during active drawing.
productionApproach: Choose drawing and motion tools from the visual requirements; Canvas 2D or SVG render, with optional cached Rough.js variants. Use HyperFrames for composition, timing, media/audio synchronization, checks, and export. Remotion is allowed only if HyperFrames is unavailable or verified unable to meet a required constraint, with the reason recorded. Keep visual rendering, motion, and pipeline responsibilities distinct; use seekable deterministic state, inspect key frames and the decoded video. For interactive HTML, bind pointer or scroll behavior to accessible controls and static/reduced-motion states.
